meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 它按 Microsoft Graph 接口帮你为 AI Agent 创建 Entra Agent Identity(Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal、每实例身份),并配置 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换与按实例的权限授予。
howto.when: 当你提到 Agent Identity Blueprint、fmi_path 令牌交换等关键词,或要为 agent 配置 OAuth 身份时触发。标准 Entra 应用注册与 Foundry agent 编写不使用它。

say.text: 用 fmi_path 两步交换给这个 agent 实例换令牌
say.note: 为实例换出独立的 Graph 令牌。

say.text: 给 agent-1 授予 User.Read.All 应用权限
say.note: 权限按单个 Agent Identity 授予。

howto.what_en: It provisions Microsoft Entra Agent Identity objects — Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, and per-instance Agent Identities — via Microsoft Graph, and configures OAuth 2.0 token exchange and permission grants.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Agent Identity Blueprint, fmi_path token exchange, or agent OAuth provisioning. Not for standard Entra app registration or Foundry agent authoring.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint and its BlueprintPrincipal for me
say_en.note: Runs Microsoft Graph calls to create both.

say_en.text: Do the two-step fmi_path exchange for this agent instance
say_en.note: Yields a token for that instance.

say_en.text: Grant User.Read.All application permission to agent-1
